wheel_model.method: Compression-only linear coils; seven small-angle rigid-body coordinates. Equilibrium solved with active spring sets and gravity roll/pitch stiffness. Body pivots share vertical height and permit truck pitch/roll. Static rail heights prescribe four wheelset heave/roll positions. Wheel reactions from spring-force moments at ±330 and guide/inertial lateral loads at Z725. Wheel/rail half spacing457.2. Primary friction, dampers, bumpers/stops, axlebox play, frame flexibility, flange forces and dynamics omitted. Responses beyond travel/contact are flagged, not accepted predictions after impact.
wheel_model.traction_basis: Steady longitudinal force per powered truck. Truck pitch couple F×1130 balances wheel traction and connection height. Body opposite couple2F×(1130−800) uses rear coupler height800. Motor/gear/brake reaction details and inertial braking must be separately resolved.
assumptions: Leading truck carries no body weight, as in LT20.
Existing CAD weights and allowances are unmeasured; all lateral CG offsets assumed zero.
Rail twist and speeds are analyst screens, not route surveys or operating limits.
Lateral guide forces split equally between truck axles; wheel-contact and flange mechanics absent.
Stop-free response is reported up to event detection. Bumper or hard-stop engagement invalidates linear travel continuation.
Primary free heights set from nominal base loads; load cases change ride height. Shims and spring tolerances require weighing and adjustment.
A positive minimum wheel force alone is not a derailment-safety demonstration.
